decisions.item_text: The self-inspection programme is designed to detect any gaps in how GMP is applied and to recommend the corrective actions needed.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement states the purpose of the programme as finding GMP gaps and recommending corrective action.
States regular self-inspection but without an approved schedule.
Same optional extra self-inspections on special occasions.
Asks only for objective evaluation, less than independent, thorough inspection by designated competent staff.
Requires corrective actions to be implemented but not on time or with effectiveness.
Only requires the procedure to be documented, without the listed contents.

decisions.item_text: An effective follow-up programme is in place for self-inspection findings.
decisions.reason: A follow-up programme as a system is not stated by any listed requirement.
Same written instructions setting a common minimum standard.

decisions.addendum: Questionnaires may be used, also covering sanitation and hygiene, label control, recall procedures, complaints handling and the results of earlier self-inspections with the corrective steps taken.
decisions.reason: Same optional coverage of areas, plus questionnaires and further areas.

decisions.addendum: Management appoints the team, made up of experts in their own fields who know GMP.
decisions.reason: Same competent self-inspection staff, adding appointment by management and GMP expertise.
Same option of team members from inside or outside the company.

decisions.addendum: Preferably at least once a year, depending on company needs.
decisions.reason: Adds a preferred minimum frequency to regular self-inspection.

decisions.addendum: The procedure states how often self-inspections are carried out.
decisions.reason: Self-inspection procedure, adding that it states the frequency.

decisions.addendum: A report is written when each self-inspection is completed.
decisions.reason: Record of each self-inspection, specified as a report on completion.

decisions.addendum: The report also includes an evaluation and conclusions.
decisions.reason: Same report content, adding evaluation and conclusions.
Same effective follow-up programme.

decisions.addendum: Management evaluates the report and the corrective actions as necessary.
decisions.reason: Findings reach management, adding that management evaluates them.
Same optional supplementary audit alongside self-inspections.
Same optional extension of audits to suppliers and contractors.

decisions.item_text: The head of quality control, together with other relevant departments, is responsible for approving suppliers able to reliably provide starting and packaging materials that meet set specifications.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement assigns supplier approval responsibility.

decisions.item_text: Suppliers are evaluated before they are approved and added to the approved supplier list or to specifications.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement states evaluation before supplier approval.

decisions.addendum: The evaluation takes into account the supplier's track record and the nature of the materials supplied.
decisions.reason: Supplier evaluation, adding what it considers.

decisions.item_text: Where a supplier audit is required, it establishes whether the supplier is able to comply with GMP.
decisions.reason: No listed requirement states the aim of a supplier audit.
Certification against the marketing authorisation and other production rules.
GMP compliance is covered by certification against the rules on production and control.

decisions.item_text: Before a batch is released, the authorised person makes sure that the main manufacturing and testing processes have been validated.
decisions.reason: A distinct release check not stated by any listed requirement.

decisions.item_text: Before a batch is released, the authorised person makes sure that every necessary check and test has been done and that production conditions and manufacturing records have been taken into account.
decisions.reason: A distinct release check not stated by any listed requirement.

decisions.item_text: Before a batch is released, the authorised person makes sure that any planned change or deviation in manufacturing or quality control was notified through a well-defined reporting system before release, including notification to and approval by the medicines regulator where needed.
decisions.reason: A distinct release check not stated by any listed requirement.

decisions.item_text: Before a batch is released, the authorised person makes sure that any extra sampling, inspection, testing and checks needed to cover planned changes and deviations have been carried out or started, as appropriate.
decisions.reason: A distinct release check not stated by any listed requirement.

decisions.item_text: Before a batch is released, the authorised person makes sure that all required production and quality control documents are complete and signed off by supervisors trained in the relevant disciplines.
decisions.reason: A distinct release check not stated by any listed requirement.

decisions.item_text: Before a batch is released, the authorised person makes sure that suitable audits, self-inspections and spot checks are carried out by experienced, trained staff.
decisions.reason: A distinct release check not stated by any listed requirement.

decisions.item_text: Before a batch is released, the authorised person makes sure that the head of quality control has given approval.
decisions.reason: A distinct release check not stated by any listed requirement.

decisions.item_text: Before a batch is released, the authorised person makes sure that all relevant factors have been considered, including those not tied directly to the batch under review, such as splitting output batches from a common input or factors linked to continuous production runs.
decisions.reason: A distinct release check not stated by any listed requirement.
